original_question: List the TR studies targeting Rel-18 and the type of impact each had on the TSs.
original_query: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(r:Release {releaseName: 'Rel-18'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (tr)-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(ti:TRImpact)-[:IMPACTS_SPEC]->(sp:Spec) RETURN DISTINCT tr.trNumber, tr.trTitle, tr.trStatus, ti.impactType, sp.specNumber ORDER BY tr.trNumber

evidence.finding: The six-study Rel-18 population is connected to seven original XML/style pairs, nine independently replayed SQL roles and complete incident evidence for 367 core nodes. Declared study impacts, implementation candidates and actual normative TS changes retain their distinct source roles.
evidence.counterauthority: Two distinct seven-unit AI reviews reconcile the original EN/KR question, legacy CSV assertions, all six release covers, direct study-WI corrections, twelve implementation candidates and 294 recovered CRs. Original source formatting preserves both a newly inserted heading and amendments to an existing heading within the same normative CR.
evidence.scope_limits: Classification uses pinned original frozen input; source witnesses, original560 admission and measured model outcomes retain their respective input scopes and denominators.
